definition.filter: WITH last AS ( SELECT user_id, arg_max(parent_asin, timestamp) AS target FROM test GROUP BY user_id ), known AS (SELECT user_id, parent_asin FROM train) SELECT last.user_id, last.target FROM last JOIN known USING (user_id)
definition.name: all_test_users

definition.filter: WITH depths AS ( SELECT user_id, count(*) AS n FROM train GROUP BY user_id ), eligible AS (SELECT user_id FROM depths WHERE n >= 2), last AS ( SELECT user_id, arg_max(parent_asin, timestamp) AS target FROM test GROUP BY user_id ), known_items AS (SELECT DISTINCT parent_asin FROM train) SELECT last.user_id, last.target FROM last JOIN eligible USING (user_id) JOIN known_items ON known_items.parent_asin = last.target
definition.name: warm_users

metric_note: exact full-catalogue ranking, no sampled negatives
